gtc.text: Aurelia, the angel who leads the Boros Legion, receives Gideon Jura in her war room, where he feels her overwhelming angelic aura, and she says she has heard he saved a Boros brigade from a Rakdos ambush.
She shows him the contested Ninth on her war table, telling him the Boros were once led by a disgrace to the Legion, and says she wishes to cleanse the Ninth.
Aurelia offers Gideon command of a battalion, whether or not he joins the Boros, and he accepts, resolving to wield Boros weapons for the greater good without becoming Boros.
She had earlier denounced Niv-Mizzet, ending the Warmind Initiative collaboration between the Boros and the Izzet.
